final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, 1.0 * s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref), margins AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM margins ORDER BY margin IS NULL, margin DESC LIMIT 10
